_comment: AF-BT's shelf fragment for AF-INT (AUDIT-FIXES-PLAN.md section 2). Whole card objects for config/shelf.json, with the fields AF-BT changes; every other field is as on main at 2aabdcc.

bsb, tahot and clear-align are held for PR H (the first PR after true-credits merges). esv is applied in AF-SH's PR, which brings the filter that hides it on Pages builds. net-bible is offered as well, because its licenseNote and citation repeat the NET line this module fixes (B12); apply it with the others in PR H.

'This copy: ...' sentences and 'kept up to date' are AF-DT's (dataset dates) and are left as they are here, except on clear-align, whose dates this module was asked for; AF-DT's fragment should use the same dates (version of 11 May 2026, commit c99bd0ae; read 8 October 2026).

Every fact is checked in docs/evidence/af-bt-2026-10-21.json on branch af-bt (records bsb-terms, bsb-first-printed, leningrad-codex-date, clear-alignment-makers, clear-version, esv-notice, net-copyright), so AF-SH need not check them again.

FIELD NAME TO SETTLE: the plan gives the esv card the filter as "when": "esv", but every card already uses 'when' for its date (shelf.rs reads it as the date shown). This fragment keeps 'when' for the date and puts the filter in "onlyWhen": "esv"; AF-SH names the field when it builds the filter in Sources.tsx (and shelf.rs, whose Work struct denies unknown fields).

cards._change: None needed: checked. 'by' names the translators and 'when' is '2016; public domain since 2023', both as the publisher's pages give them (Bible Hub: printed 2016, 2020, 2022 and 2025; berean.bible terms: dedicated to the public domain 30 April 2023). Bible Hub's line today also names unfoldingWord and Bible Aquifer among the partners; the card keeps the 2023 terms page's list.
cards.title: Berean Standard Bible (BSB)
cards.by: The Berean Bible Translation Committee, with Bible Hub, Discovery Bible and OpenBible.com

cards._change: by and what name the manuscript and its date; citation names the manuscript. The 'This copy' sentence is left for AF-DT.
cards.plain: Hebrew Old Testament, word by word
cards.title: Translators Amalgamated Hebrew OT (TAHOT)
cards.by: The Leningrad Codex (about AD 1008), tagged by STEPBible.org, based on work at Tyndale House, Cambridge
cards.what: Every Hebrew and Aramaic word of the Old Testament, from the Leningrad Codex (about AD 1008), with its root, its grammar and an English meaning.
cards.citation: STEPBible, TAHOT: Translators Amalgamated Hebrew OT, from the Leningrad Codex (St Petersburg, National Library of Russia, Firkovich Evr. I B 19a; about AD 1008). Data created by www.STEPBible.org based on work at Tyndale House Cambridge (CC BY 4.0). github.com/STEPBible/STEPBible-Data. This copy: October 2026.

cards._change: by names who made each set of links and who publishes them; when and citation give the version's date and the date it was read.
cards.plain: Word links from Hebrew and Greek to English
cards.title: Clear Bible word alignments for the BSB
cards.by: The Berean Bible team (the Greek links) and BiblioNexus (the Hebrew links), published by Clear Bible (Biblica)
cards.what: Links from each Hebrew, Aramaic and Greek word to the words of the BSB that translate it, made by hand. They let the app color matching words.
cards.licenseNote: The alignments are CC BY 4.0; the Hebrew (WLC) and BSB texts they link are public domain.
cards.citation: Clear Bible / Biblica, Alignments: BSB manual alignments BGNT-BSB (made by the Berean Bible team) and WLCM-BSB (made by BiblioNexus), github.com/Clear-Bible/Alignments (CC BY 4.0). Version of 11 May 2026 (commit c99bd0ae), read 8 October 2026.
